blocks.heading: Cisco Webex cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Cisco Webex against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Webex Free until a gated capability (AI assistance (Webex Free, Webex Meet, Webex Suite, Webex Enterprise, Webex Contact Center)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (cloud phone, call routing, call recording) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Paid Meet/Suite seat dollars are medium confidence — pricing UI is region/SKU dynamic. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Paid Meet/Suite seat dollars are medium confidence — pricing UI is region/SKU dynamic

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Full Calling + Contact Center depth is often EA/quote layered beyond Suite list floors

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: AI Assistant and advanced CC AI frequently sold as add-ons or higher SKUs

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: SMB buyers may find Cisco packaging heavier than OpenPhone/Vonage self-serve phones

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: WhatsApp Business and shared-inbox depth trail messaging/CCaaS specialists
